exposure: mode of birth (caesarean or normal childbirth)
cohort: 145 women in a Private-General Obstetrics and Pediatric Clinic in Greece who completed questionnaires on the third and fourth day after delivery.
finding: Postpartum depression symptoms are significantly associated with a lower quality of life in women after pregnancy, and specific demographic factors like place of residence and education level are associated with higher levels of postpartum depression symptoms.
cross-section timing: third and fourth day after delivery
